title: Hayes Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical, urgent care, and local readiness help points in Hayes.
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 right away. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: Hillingdon Hospital (Pield Heath Road, Uxbridge UB8 3NN) — 24-hour A&E. Travel from Hayes & Harlington station: ~2.5 miles north-west; take bus U4 or U5 towards Uxbridge (~20 mins), or walk north along Station Road, Coldharbour Lane, and west on Pield Heath Road (~45 mins). Ealing Hospital (Uxbridge Road, Southall UB1 3HW) — 24-hour A&E. Travel from Hayes town centre: ~3 miles east along the A4020 Uxbridge Road; take bus 207 or SL8 east towards White City (~20 mins). Nearest Major Trauma Centre is St Mary's Hospital (Praed Street, Paddington W2 1NY). 2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres: Hillingdon Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre (co-located at Hillingdon Hospital, Pield Heath Road UB8 3NN) — open 24 hours for urgent non-life-threatening illness and minor injuries. 3. Local Hazard Notes: River Crane and Yeading Brook run through eastern and northern Hayes; low-lying parkland and road crossings are prone to surface and fluvial flooding during heavy rainfall. Grand Union Canal also runs east-west through south Hayes. 4. Supplies: Pharmacies and supermarkets along Station Road, Coldharbour Lane, and the Uxbridge Road corridor can supply bottled water, basic medicines, and first-aid provisions. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
